name: flatten-anything
description: Flatten objects and replace nested props with 'prop.subprop'. A simple and small integration

scripts.release: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm test && bumpp --no-push --all && pnpm publish --no-git-checks && npx jsr publish ${JSR_TOKEN:+--token $JSR_TOKEN} && git push --follow-tags && gh release create $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0) --generate-notes --notes "$(git log --pretty='- %s  %h' $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD~1 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)..HEAD~1)"
